highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: This is a breaking release that rolls up all v4 preview work: the Skia engine jumps from m132 to m148, variable font and color font palette support land, animated WebP encoding is added, and the singleton/handle lifecycle is fundamentally reworked. Review the breaking changes section before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface — text measures as zero
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs), so MeasureText/DrawText return nothing. Migration: pass an explicit typeface, e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect 'unset' with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default, not null
breaking.body: The underlying font moved from a null/lazy default to an explicit SKTypeface.Default. Text still renders, but paint.Typeface == null checks no longer fire. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty or drop the null check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName for a missing family now returns Default on all platforms
breaking.body: Android used to return null for an unknown family; now all platforms return SKTypeface.Default for consistency. For a strict null-on-miss, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) which still returns null when no match is found.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws on out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit; the long overload was silently truncating. It is now [Obsolete] and does a checked cast — large offsets throw OverflowException. Migrate to Move(int), clamping or validating the value yourself.

breaking.title: SKPaint legacy text/font members are now compile errors
breaking.body: Members obsoleted in v3 (e.g. TextSize, Typeface on SKPaint) were promoted to compile errors. Move typeface and text-size configuration onto SKFont.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter was part of the old lifecycle API and has been removed. Subclasses that wrote to it must stop; the property is now read-only.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo type changed; GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo was retyped from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. The old struct lost IEquatable, == and != operators. Update type references and equality checks.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative: five fields removed (fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, fOwnsInstanceAndDevice)
breaking.body: These interop fields were dropped upstream. Use fVkExtensions in place of fExtensions, and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures. The ownership and version-redundancy fields have no replacement — simply remove those assignments.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process (not returns null) on Vulkan 1.0
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a Vulkan 1.0 instance or leaving GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion at its default 0 triggers SK_ABORT — a fatal abort, not an exception. Set apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both VkApplicationInfo and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion. Genuinely 1.0-only hardware must use a different backend.

bullets.lead: Skia updated from m132 to m148
bullets.detail: The bundled engine covers milestones m132 through m148, including several rounds of upstream chrome/m147 and m148 bug-fix merges.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: Variable font axes can now be set on SKTypeface, and color font palettes are fully supported via new palette APIs. HarfBuzzSharp gains matching variable-axis access.
SKWebpEncoder now supports encoding multi-frame animated WebP images, covering a frequently requested feature gap.
A new GetData() method on SKStream returns the stream's underlying data without copying, enabling efficient pipelines that pass stream content to other APIs.
Both draw methods now accept SKSamplingOptions for control over filtering quality when blitting a surface onto a canvas.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzzSharp: HBColor struct and missing API wrappers
bullets.detail: A new HBColor struct correctly maps hb_color_t. Several missing API wrappers were added and naming-convention violations corrected.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic (Android NDK libc) native asset support
bullets.detail: Native assets for Linux Bionic are now built and shipped, enabling SkiaSharp in environments that use the Android NDK C runtime on Linux.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support
bullets.detail: The Tizen platform now builds native assets for both x64 and arm64.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset fixes
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan was using Height instead of Width to compute the x-axis offset, and the wrong stride for row indexing. Both are now correct.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first
bullets.detail: A race between the SKPath and SKPathBuilder finalizers could crash the process. The finalizer ordering is now safe.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution moved to managed layer
bullets.detail: Default-typeface resolution no longer calls into native on Android API 36+, fixing crashes when the system font manager returns null.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI consumers on .NET 9 could hit a DLL-not-found error for the WinUI projection assembly; this is now resolved.

bullets.lead: SKGLView stops rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switch on Android
bullets.detail: An Android MAUI TabBar switch caused the GLView to lose its render surface. The view now correctly re-initializes after regaining focus.
The way SkiaSharp manages singleton and shared native instances has been fundamentally redesigned to prevent double-dispose, use-after-free, and premature finalization bugs.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi constructor
bullets.detail: The native binary compatibility check now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor rather than a module initializer, improving reliability and error messaging at startup.

bullets.lead: Apple platform TFMs corrected: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp libraries now target platform version 26.0 on Apple platforms, while app-facing packages use unversioned TFMs, matching the recommended pattern for library authors.

bullets.lead: WASM: pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native builds dropped
bullets.detail: Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions before the .NET 8 era are no longer produced, reducing artifact size.
The bundled libexpat has been updated to 2.8.1 for security and stability.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz updated to 14.2.0, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, libpng to 1.6.58, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libexpat to 2.7.5
bullets.detail: All bundled native dependencies have been refreshed to current stable versions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Variable font and color font palette support, HarfBuzzSharp variable-axis APIs, singleton lifecycle rework, SKPath finalizer fix, SKPaint legacy API promotion, and Uno gallery sample updates
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native asset support and PolySharp C# 13 compatibility on legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Android MAUI TabBar SKGLView re-render fix

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 stabilized the 4.148.0 API surface: SKPixmap GetPixelSpan fixes, pre-v4 obsolete promotions to error, and the final round of m147/m148 upstream merges.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 landed HarfBuzz 14.2.0, libjpeg-turbo and zlib bumps, HBColor and missing HarfBuzz wrappers, the WASM Emscripten simplification, and a large CI and build-system modernization.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), the SKPath finalizer fix, Apple TFM corrections, and further CI hardening.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m132–m147 engine jump, variable fonts, color palettes, SKCanvas.DrawSurface sampling options, Linux Bionic support, Tizen multi-arch builds, and the SKPaint/SKFont API migration.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 adds a proper HBColor struct for hb_color_t, fills in several missing API wrappers, corrects naming-convention violations, and updates the underlying harfbuzz native library to 14.2.0.
